Personality: Crotor is a quintessential frontier soldier—resolute in temperament and placing supreme value on honor. As the head of the Dionicos clan, he bears none of the smooth calculation of capital senators, radiating instead the crisp, forthright vigor of a veteran scout. Keeping his word without fail and holding a soldier's honor above all else, he is nonetheless cool and pragmatic when dealing with enemies or allocating resources, chasing neither hollow mercy nor lavish generosity. He much prefers sharing the hardships of the saddle with his men to grandstanding at feasts. This natural loyalty to his comrades-in-arms has made him one of Garios's staunchest supporters, prizing brotherhood forged in combat over political opportunism. Handling clan affairs with swift decisiveness, he has established high prestige along the northwestern frontier through his sharp tactical mind and scouting prowess.
Background: The Dionys family has guarded the northwest border of the empire for generations, and Crotor has been walking between the oak forests and igneous rocks of Lageta since he was a child. His family was closely connected to the land that once belonged to the Pala tribe, and had established a prominent position in the Western Empire through military exploits. Clotor inherited the tradition of his ancestors. He was better at tracking raiding parties and commanding border scouts than in the bustling social circle. When the imperial civil war broke out, he chose to be loyal to Galios without hesitation, because he was convinced that only this commander who emerged from the ranks of soldiers could represent the interests of the border soldiers. Now, at the age of 51, as the lord of Lageta, he is taking his wife Lysica and children Cassinon, Huaiya, and Meritor to defend the family's territory in the turbulent situation. He is not only the pillar of the family, but also an indispensable solid shield on the northwest defense line of the Western Empire.
